name: GET /api/leadflow/workflows/runs - rehearsals and real runs, kept apart
description:
Local dry runs and upstream live runs, returned as SEPARATE lists and never merged. They look alike and mean opposite things — one is a rehearsal, the other reached a customer — and a single list invites reading a rehearsal as evidence that something happened.

An unreachable workflow service is named rather than letting live_runs come back empty and read as "nothing ran".

testCases.name: rehearsals and real runs, kept apart
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
